video_title: Nobody Tells You THIS About Playing in China

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: D'Angelo Russell and Brandon Goodwin on team dynamics and guard play
quotes.excerpt: We got two really good guards, me and D-Lo. I'm excited to see how it's going to look.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: Obviously we got two really good guards, me and D-Lo. I'm excited to see how it's going to look further down the line.

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Goodwin
text_blocks.text: I think they got a great group, a great foundation, some of the best players in China, some of the best domestic players on this team.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: D'Angelo Russell on the importance of aggressive play in the CBA
quotes.excerpt: You came in aggressive. That's most important. I think for us, we don't have a lot of scores.
quotes.quote: Other players, I feel like they come and they can't adjust to the pace. They turn the ball over, not being aggressive. You came in aggressive. That's most important. I think for us, we don't have a lot of scores that can create off the dribble. So you coming in being aggressive off rip, no matter if it's falling or not, that's going to be very important for us.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: D'Angelo Russell on the necessity of involving local players for championships
quotes.excerpt: You're going to need your locals. You're going to need Kevin, Steve, Wang, Terry.
quotes.quote: You're going to need your locals. You're going to need Kevin, Steve, Wang, Terry. You got to get them involved, and that's the only way you're going to win a championship, because there's only one of us in the four.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: D'Angelo Russell on the importance of finishing games strong
quotes.excerpt: Whoever is hooping to start the quarter, they go finish the game.
quotes.quote: Whoever is hooping to start the quarter, they go finish the game. That's the game. For sure. Like if I'm hooping to start the quarter, when you come in and finish the game, I'm cool with that recipe. We get it in the first three quarters, so now at the end of the game, there ain't no pressure.
